display.purpose: Poster-like statement text in black/red sections.

body.purpose: Readable community copy, logistics, and descriptions.

nav.purpose: Sticky header links and simple site movement.

shadows.name: header-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the sticky header from scrolling content.

motion.name: footer-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveals the fixed footer on large hover-capable screens.

motion.name: slider-view-transition
motion.purpose: Preserves continuity from list pages to detail pages.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Plain inherited-color link with underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font-family: "Open Sans Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-nav-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary-clr); outline-offset: 0.25em; }

components.name: Event Flyer Tile
components.description: Full image event tile with no decorative frame.
components.css: .ds-event-flyer { display: block; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-event-flyer img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 0; } .ds-event-flyer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary-clr); outline-offset: 0.35em; }

components.name: Image Text Row
components.description: Compact board or sponsor row with a square image and text.
components.html:
President: Name

Short community description.
components.css: .ds-image-text { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 2ch; align-items: start; font-family: "Open Sans Variable", sans-serif; color: var(--primary-clr); } .ds-image-text img { width: 100px; height: 100px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 0; } .ds-image-text h2 { margin: 0; padding-block-start: 0.175em; line-height: 1cap; } .ds-image-text p { margin-block-start: 1em; text-wrap: balance; }

components.name: Black Red Community Section
components.description: Signature poster section using Stage Black, Signal Red, and Room Light.
components.css: .ds-black-red { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--primary-clr); color: var(--tertiary-clr); font-family: "Open Sans Variable", sans-serif; font-variation-settings: "wght" 300, "wdth" 75; font-size: clamp(0.875em, 2.625cqi + 0.25em, 2.375em); line-height: 2cap; padding: 1cap; border-radius: 0; } .ds-black-red p { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-block-start: 1cap; } .ds-signal-shape { position: absolute; inset-block-end: 0; inset-inline-end: 0; width: 42%; height: 65%; background: var(--secondary-clr); clip-path: polygon(22% 0%, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 48% 100%); }

components.name: Plain Primary Button
components.description: A future-compatible button derived from the existing link and black/red vocabulary.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { appearance: none; border: 1px solid var(--primary-clr); border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary-clr); color: var(--tertiary-clr); font-family: "Open Sans Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 0.75em 1em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--secondary-clr); outline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview: The GRWebDev system should feel like a real local notice board outside a well-used event room: practical, public, friendly, and a little handmade. It is not a corporate conference brand. It should help newcomers understand what is happening, who is involved, and where they can show up without needing insider status.
keyCharacteristics: Public, local, and easy to scan.
Poster-like blocks instead of decorative cards.
Real community artifacts: event flyers, board photos, sponsor logos, venue maps.
Strong black/red contrast, softened by accessible Room Light usage.
Plain language and visible next steps.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Wallpaper Rule
rules.body: Signal Red should point at important structure or energy. Do not scatter it as a generic accent.

rules.name: The Room Stays Open Rule
rules.body: Dark sections must preserve enough Room Light contrast for newcomers scanning logistics, names, dates, and links.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Stay with Open Sans Variable unless there is a deliberate brand reason to add another family. The current system gets its range from weight, width, scale, and layout.

rules.name: The Plain Invitation Rule
rules.body: Typography should sound and look like people inviting people. Avoid all-caps institutional labels and over-styled conference language.

rules.name: The Flat Bulletin Rule
rules.body: Do not add card shadows to make lists feel designed. Use spacing, imagery, typography, and grid position first.

dos: Do use real community artifacts: event flyers, board photos, sponsor logos, venue maps, and organization details.
Do keep layouts public and scannable, especially for dates, names, locations, and next steps.
Do preserve the Stage Black, Signal Red, and Room Light relationship.
Do use the outdent grid to create a confident local-poster layout.
Do support WCAG 2.2 AA, reduced motion preferences, keyboard-friendly navigation, visible focus states, and contrast that does not rely on red and black alone.
donts: Don't make the site feel corporate.
Don't use polished enterprise sameness, stock-photo professionalism, investor-deck language, generic SaaS sections, or sterile tech conference aesthetics.
Don't imply exclusivity, insider status, hustle culture, or a narrow definition of who counts as a developer.
Don't replace real community imagery with decorative abstract panels.
Don't add side-stripe card borders, gradient text, glassmorphism, identical icon-card grids, or hero-metric templates.
Don't use Signal Red as wallpaper. It should carry direction or emphasis.
